svg.title: Sharp's University
svg.desc: Euclid, Elements I.1 — two circles, each struck through the other's centre, meeting to construct an equilateral triangle. The first proposition, and the first thing anyone builds with a compass and straightedge. The triangle is filled rather than outlined: a solid shape is what survives at tab and file-tree sizes, which is exactly where the earlier outlined seal collapsed. No letters — a monogram in a square said nothing about what this school teaches.
